plan-the-builders-set-the-upper-bound.text: Plan: the builders set the upper bound.

approach.text: The builders that lack a bound take one from the same time conversion the booking builder uses, with the same horizon limit, so each new bound is the one a person already gets on a booking. The recovery rule that already exists then applies to them with no change of its own: a body with an upper bound can be excluded or declared dead once the tip passes it. The census of builders is part of the work, because a builder reached only by one command is easy to miss.

slice.text: One slice and one pull request: the three builders, the recovery and creation controls extended to an update and a booking, the regenerated receipts and goldens, and the pages.

consumers-the-gate-names-at-intake.text: Consumers the gate names at intake.
